ref: #2 §4 replaceValue: "Replaces the value I with a value that you can define in the dialog for the function parameters." and removeContexts: "Removes all higher-level contexts of a source field" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/43/c4cdfc334824478090739c04c4a249/content.htm]
note: replaceValue(removeContexts(Sku), X), Sku in its default context Line: a | b | c over two Orders. removeContexts puts the three values into one context and replaceValue replaces each, so All is X, X, X. Without removeContexts the root's slot reads context 1 only and All is X once.
